pages.text:
Anna and Mim set up a
picnic on the sand.

They sat on a rug and
had snacks and drinks.

The ants crept into
the nuts.

The ants crept onto
the drinks.

Anna hit the ants but
they did not go.

Mim stamped on the ants
to get rid of them.

Anna and Mim had set
the picnic on an ant nest.

They had to pack up the
snacks in a bag but left
some nuts on the sand.
